scope: Full data backup and scratch restore; read-only inspection of Linux launchers
verified_behaviors: Archive includes the main database, research and telemetry databases, and private photos; SHA-256 values match, and runtime/session.key is excluded.
Restored main database has 120 notices, the research fixture retains its row, and the restored photo bytes match.
A live database changed to 119 notices remains unchanged after restoring the archived 120-notice snapshot into a new folder; existing destinations are rejected.
A traversal entry is rejected without creating the destination or escaped file.
A corrupted photo payload is rejected without creating the restored destination.

concrete_findings.title: A backup within the advertised file-count limit can exceed the restore manifest limit
concrete_findings.evidence: create_full_backup permits 9,999 payload files and writes an indented JSON manifest without checking its byte length; restore_full_check rejects manifests above 1,048,576 bytes. A read-only calculation with 1 database entry and 9,998 allowed photo paths produced a 1,819,930-byte manifest before realistic database metadata is added.
concrete_findings.impact: A sufficiently large photo collection may produce a successful backup that this restore checker rejects.
concrete_findings.recommendation: Make archive creation and restoration use consistent manifest-size and file-count limits.
concrete_findings.verification: Code inspection plus serializer-size calculation; a 9,999-file end-to-end archive was not created.

static_observations: SQLite snapshots use the online backup API; restore validates hashes, database integrity, foreign keys, table counts, photo references, allowed paths, duplicate entries, symlink entries, encryption flags, and archive size.
The archive is a set of separately captured SQLite snapshots and copied photos; its own instructions require pausing app changes for cross-resource consistency.
Restore uses a fresh scratch directory and does not implement replacement of live project data.

Linux launchers share quoted path handling and set -euo pipefail; setup requires Python 3.10+, creates a cached Linux virtual environment, installs pinned requirements when their hash changes, and does not invoke sudo.
The Linux database viewer binds to 127.0.0.1 with read-only flags; scripts have no UTF-8 BOM or CRLF line endings.

manifest_limit_analysis.analysis: Read-only manifest-size calculation using the exact serializer and the allowed maximum file count; no backup was created

coverage_limits: Tests were executed only on Windows using the copied bundled python/python.exe.
Linux launchers, virtual environment creation, dependency installation, and Linux runtime behavior were inspected only and were not executed.
The four assigned tests are synthetic automated technical checks, not a human study. Nominal human usability is untested.
Concurrent writers, disk exhaustion or interrupted final moves, actual large archives, and every malformed archive variant were not tested.
No application or test source was edited. All review writes were confined to this reviewer folder.
